property_summary: For any clone deployed from C (reference), owner() returns the address encoded in the first immutable argument slot (the 0x0 offset), so owner() equals the first address in the creation data; the mutant reads the second immutable arg (0x14) and thus will return a different address whenever the first and second encoded addresses differ.
change_summary: Replace the returned immutable argument index from 0x0 to 0x14 so owner() returns the address encoded at the second immutable arg instead of the first.
